questions.exam_year_tag: GATE PH Topic • Atomic & Molecular Physics #2
questions.question_en: What is the Landé g-factor (g_J) for the atomic state ³P₁?
questions.question_hi: परमाण्वीय अवस्था ³P₁ के लिए लैंडे g-गुणक (Landé g-factor, g_J) का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation_en:
STEP-BY-STEP DERIVATION:
1. From the spectroscopic term symbol ²ˢ⁺¹L_J = ³P₁:
   • 2S + 1 = 3  ⇒  S = 1
   • P state  ⇒  L = 1
   • Total angular momentum J = 1.
2. Landé g-factor formula:
   g_J = 1 + [ J(J+1) + S(S+1) - L(L+1) ] / [ 2 J(J+1) ].
3. Since S = L = 1, the terms S(S+1) and L(L+1) cancel out:
   g_J = 1 + [ 1(2) + 1(2) - 1(2) ] / [ 2 × 1(2) ] = 1 + 2/4 = 1 + 1/2 = 3/2 = 1.5.
